entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Revisionist :- Misri Lal
Opposite Party :- State

Counsel for Revisionist :- K K Bhatt
Counsel for Opposite Party :- A.G.A.
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
Notice was issued to revisionist to engage another counsel vide Court's order dated 22.05.2015.
Office report dated 01.08.2019 shows that Sri K.K. Bhatt, Advocate has filed his Vakalatnama as counsel for revisionist but none is present to press this revision.
No other counsel has appeared though the case is called in revise.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by judgement and order dated 14.07.1993 passed by Vth Additional Sessions Judge, Allahabad in Criminal Appeal No.
1 of 1990, Misri Lal v. State of U.P., dismissing said appeal and confirming conviction of appellant under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentencing to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1,000/- awarded by learned Judicial Magistrate III,
Allahabad, in Criminal Case No. 1058 of 1989.
Misri Lal vs State on 2 August, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137325766/
1 3.

Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
5. Certify this judgment to the lower Court immediately.

Order Date :- 2.8.2019 Siddhant Sahu  Misri Lal vs State on 2 August, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137325766/
